description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different models on three tasks: Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy. The horizontal axis represents the model categories, labeled as Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE, while the vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy / Correlation" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Each model category is represented by a group of three bars, colored beige, pink, and blue, corresponding to Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy, respectively. The beige bars for Sentiment Accuracy remain relatively consistent across models, with values around 0.52-0.55. The pink bars for STS Correlation show an increasing trend, with values ranging from approximately 0.51 for Single-task_baseline to 0.81 for 2-Tier SimCSE. The blue bars for Paraphrase Accuracy are highest for Single-task_baseline and Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, with values around 0.79-0.8, and slightly lower for Unsupervised_SimCSE and 2-Tier SimCSE, with values around 0.76-0.78. The bars within each group are not sorted, but the model categories are presented in a specific order along the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized.
